channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Debate na Globo: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro se enfrentam antes do 2º turno
item.description: In the Globo debate, Flávio Bolsonaro said his government plan aims to end illegal deforestation in the Amazon by 2029, criticized the IBAMA and ICMBio, and defended that institutions should stop acting ideologically. He also stated he will govern thinking about the future, contrasting himself with Lula.

item.title: Flávio leva governadores eleitos e deixa Marçal de fora do debate da Globo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro gathers elected governors in his entourage for the Globo debate, excluding influencer Pablo Marçal, who supported him in the pre-campaign. The strategy reinforces institutional alliances to expand support in the 2026 election.

item.title: Troca de seções eleitorais foi solicitada por tribunais estaduais
item.description: The exchange of polling sections was requested by state courts, not by a unilateral decision from the TSE president. The change aims to prevent unforeseen events on election day, as clarified by the Regional Electoral Courts.

item.title: Pazolini aciona Justiça contra ataques por telefone disfarçados de pesquisa no ES
item.description: Lorenzo Pazolini's coalition (Republicanos) filed a criminal complaint with the TSE of Espírito Santo against automated calls disguised as polls that attack Pazolini and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The campaign alleges these calls mislead voters to discredit the candidates.

item.title: Lula usa último programa para atacar Flávio, e rival aposta em sertanejos e oração
item.description: In the final stretch, Lula and Flávio release contrasting campaign ads: Lula focuses on attacks over corruption and proposed cuts, whereas Flávio leans on country singer endorsements and prayers without direct confrontations.

item.title: Alckmin faz agenda ao lado de Paes no Rio, e defende reta final sem 'interferência' do TSE nos canais de WhatsApp
item.description: Geraldo Alckmin defended that the TSE should not interfere in WhatsApp channels during the final stretch of the 2026 elections, during an event in Rio de Janeiro alongside Eduardo Paes. He criticized the suspension of the 'Exército do Lula' channel and emphasized the importance of dialogue with voters regarding health and education. Surveys show a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula in the runoff.

item.title: Doria com Flávio, Cabral com Lula: o peso dos apoios na reta final
item.description: In the final stretch of the runoff, João Doria announced support for Flávio Bolsonaro, while Sérgio Cabral released a video backing Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Renan Santos of the Missão movement claimed voters for candidate 22 are 'humiliated', and on Papo Antagonista, Duda Teixeira, Gabriel Oliveira and Carlos Graieb analyzed the strategies behind these last-minute endorsements.

item.title: Flávio pagou R$ 1,6 milhão a impulsionamento de posts contra Lula em 3 dias
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) spent $1.6 million boosting 19 anti-Lula posts on Meta platforms between October 20-22. Lula's campaign requested disqualification over economic power abuse, while Meta denies preferential treatment of posts.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro x Lula no debate da Globo: horário, onde assistir ao vivo e regras
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula debate on Globo at 9:30 PM, divided into four blocks with set time rules. The debate is live on TV Globo, GloboNews and digital platforms, mediated by César Tralli.

item.title: As comitivas de peso dos candidatos no debate da TV Globo
item.description: President Lula will attend the TV Globo debate accompanied by key allies including Camilo Santana and Rafael Fonteles. Prominent opposition figures such as Haddad and Marina Silva were absent from the event, with André Janones focusing on social media outreach.

item.title: “Quem checa os checadores?”: o problema da checagem no debate
item.description: Lula's campaign requested real-time fact-checking during the TV Globo debate, while Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign threatened legal action. The hosts of Papo Antagonista discuss whether it is appropriate for a moderator to assess the truthfulness of candidates' statements.

item.title: Deputado eleito pelo PL confronta professor por vídeo eleitoral para alunos
item.description: Elected federal deputy Victor Jansen (PL) confronted a teacher at CEM Urso Branco over a video making a political-electoral appeal to students. The teacher was accused of using his position to influence students, which the lawmaker deemed a form of political indoctrination. The District Federal Secretariat of Education forwarded the case to its ombudsman for investigation.

item.title: Em podcast, Eduardo Bolsonaro questiona urnas e defende que Flávio deixe o País se perder eleição
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro suggested that Flávio leave the country if he loses the election and questioned the reliability of electronic voting machines on the 'Louder with Crowder' podcast. He also commented on potential investigations against his brother after losing parliamentary immunity.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula se enfrentam no último debate da eleição
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro faced off in the final presidential debate on Globo, lasting nearly two and a half hours. The debate was marked by accusations, particularly regarding corruption, with Flávio calling Lula 'nine fingers' and the PT candidate retaliating with references to militia. The broadcaster set rules including time limits per block and restrictions on movement during the opponent's speech.

item.title: Bastidores do debate da Globo: o que as campanhas tentaram impor
item.description: Gabriel de Oliveira from TV Pop reveals behind-the-scenes details of the debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro on TV Globo, which expects ratings of 30 to 35 points. The network is tense after Band's performance and criticism of César Tralli's moderation. Both campaigns attempted to influence the debate dynamics.

item.title: Meta diz ao TSE não ver infração em canal “Exército do Lula”
item.description: Meta told the TSE that the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel, run by lawmaker André Janones, does not violate platform rules. The company also reviewed the legislator's posts on Instagram and found no irregular coordinated activity.

item.title: Estrelas de Hollywood fazem o L e pedem voto em Lula
item.description: Hollywood stars and Brazilian artists released a video endorsing Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's reelection. The video, posted by Kleber Mendonça Filho, features names like Tilda Swinton, Javier Bardem, and Pedro Almodóvar. While Lula leads with 150 celebrity supporters, Flávio Bolsonaro has only 18, according to a Poder360 survey.

item.title: Tarcísio cita “legado de atraso” do PT e pede voto em Flávio
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas, re-elected governor of São Paulo, released a video endorsing Flávio Bolsonaro for president, criticizing PT for an alleged 'legacy of backwardness'. He noted Lula was already a candidate in 1989, emphasizing the party's long trajectory. The post was published by O Antagonista.

item.title: Cueva manda retirar áudio enganoso sobre voto de mesários de ‘Tropa do Flávio’ sob pena de suspensão
item.description: The Brazilian Electoral Court's chief justice, Minister Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, ordered the removal of a misleading audio posted by lawmaker-elect Gustavo Gayer, who falsely claimed poll workers were voting in place of abstaining voters, threatening suspension and a $100,000 hourly fine. The injunction was granted in a lawsuit filed by Lula's coalition against PL opponents such as Flávio Bolsonaro and Alfredo Gaspar, aiming to prevent misinformation and ensure electoral integrity ahead of the 2026 elections. Cueva emphasized the need to protect voting freedom and maintain fairness among candidates during the pre-election period.

item.title: Manifestantes protestam contra Flávio na frente do TSE; veja fotos
item.description: Protesters gathered outside the TSE in Brasília to demonstrate against senator and presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, demanding the release of confidential information and referencing the case of 5-year-old Ana Clara. Lula proposed a debate on opening tax, financial, and telecommunications records during a TV debate, but neither candidate has disclosed the data so far. The protest also targeted TSE and STF minister Kassio Nunes Marques and criticized Flávio's defense of a police officer accused in the Ana Clara case.

item.title: ‘Espero mostrar que nossas propostas são melhores’, diz Flávio ao chegar à Globo para debate
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) arrived at Globo's studios for the presidential debate and stated he will show that his proposals are the best, contrasting them with what he calls 'everything wrong' represented by Lula. Following a first debate on Band marked by attacks, both campaigns signal a more moderate tone to win undecided voters.

item.title: AO VIVO: Acompanhe o debate da TV Globo entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro debate on Friday, 23, on TV Globo, the last face-off before the runoff. The debate, hosted by César Tralli, will have four Q&A blocks and will be fact-checked by g1.

item.title: Ministro do TSE mantém ‘Tropa do Flávio’ no ar, mas manda remover áudio com fake news sobre eleição
item.description: Electoral court chief Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva kept the WhatsApp channel 'Tropa do Flávio' active but ordered the removal of an audio containing fake news about the election, threatening suspension if irregularities persist. The ruling also imposes a fine of 100,000 BRL per hour for non-compliance and per unauthorized republication of banned content.

item.title: Alok cobra TSE por transporte de indígenas no 2º turno
item.description: Alok demanded the TSE to ensure transportation for indigenous people in the 2026 runoff elections, citing logistical challenges and offering to fund trips, though electoral law prohibits private support. The Public Defender's Office also requested the STF for free public transport for traditional communities. The law guarantees transport for voters in indigenous territories, prohibiting vote influence.

item.title: Irmão de Cleitinho se revolta com presidente da AMM por apoio a Lula
item.description: State representative Eduardo Azevedo (PL), brother of Minas Gerais governor-elect Cleitinho Azevedo, publicly criticized Lucas Vieira Lopes (PSB), president of the Mineiro Association of Municipalities (AMM), for supporting President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT). The dispute arose after Lucas endorsed Lula in the second round of elections, heightening tensions among political allies in Minas Gerais.

item.title: Datafolha: 27% veem China como parceiro comercial confiável; 22% dizem o mesmo dos EUA
item.description: Datafolha poll shows 27% of Brazilian voters consider China a trustworthy commercial partner, against 22% for the US. Distrust about China dropped from 29% to 24%, while trust in the US fell from 46% to 38%. Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula are technically tied with 47% and 46% of vote intentions, respectively.

item.title: Meta diz que canal 'Exército do Lula' não viola políticas da empresa
item.description: Meta stated that the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel does not violate its policies, following an analysis requested by the TSE. The company emphasized that legitimate political coordination is not prohibited, distinguishing it from violent or criminal activities. The Electoral Public Ministry questions whether Meta applied equal measures to the presidential campaigns.

item.title: Criador do movimento pelo fim da escala 6×1 estará na plateia de Lula no debate da TV Globo
item.description: Federal Deputy-elect Rick Azevedo, creator of the movement to end the 6×1 rule, attended the Globo TV presidential debate studio, where he will be in President Lula's audience alongside Guilherme Boulos, Chief of Staff of the Presidency.

item.title: Google descarta coordenação automatizada de integrantes do canal ‘Exército do Lula’
item.description: Google told the TSE it found no automated coordination in the 'Exército do Lula' channel, distinguishing legitimate human mobilization from bot manipulation. Social network X detected only 3% automation and suspended 12,454 suspicious accounts. Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign claimed followers were being directed to search specific terms to influence election results.

item.title: Datafolha: 60% acreditam que economia do país vai melhorar nos próximos 6 meses, e 66% afirmam que sua situação também será melhor
item.description: Datafolha survey shows 60% of respondents expect Brazil's economy to improve in the next six months, the highest since October 2022. Personal improvement expectations reach 66%, particularly among youth and Lula voters. Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula remain in a technical tie in the presidential race, with 47% and 46% vote intentions.

item.title: Tropa do Flávio atua contra Janones no X; Exército do Lula reage
item.description: The digital clash between the Tropa do Flávio and Exército do Lula WhatsApp channels has turned into a battleground of narratives on X, with each faction pushing hashtags to shape public discourse. While Flávio's allies briefly boosted the phrase 'Vai pro debate, Leandra', Lula's base ultimately took control of the trending topics. The conflict stems from a legal dispute involving André Janones and his ex-partner Leandra Guedes, who are under court-ordered distance restrictions.

item.title: Flávio convida ex de Janones, que tem medida protetiva, para debate
item.description: The PL invited Leandra Guedes, a former partner of André Janones under a restraining order, to the presidential debate on TV Globo, preventing him from participating. Thus, Janones, a Lula supporter, will be kept away from the key debate ahead of the runoff.

item.title: Meta, Google e X dizem não haver irregularidades no canal 'Exército do Lula' após ordem de Nunes Marques
item.description: Meta told the TSE it found no irregularities in the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel, stating political mobilization is lawful and distinct from fraudulent coordinated actions. The company explained WhatsApp policies prohibit publishing falsehoods or coordinating illegal activities, but do not target legitimate political movements. It requested an additional five days to analyze documents delivered on a USB drive.

item.title: Alceu Valença repudia uso de “Anunciação” em vídeo de ato pró-Flávio
item.description: Singer Alceu Valença publicly rejected the use of his song 'Anunciação' in a video supporting Flávio Bolsonaro, shared by the 'Bloco do 22 Pernambuco' social media profiles. He stated that he did not authorize the use of his work for political purposes and condemned the partisan appropriation of his art. His statement was released on Friday, the 23rd.

item.title: Lula pede cassação de Flávio por ligação de verba de Dark Horse ao PCC
item.description: Lula's campaign requested the cancellation of Flávio Bolsonaro's ticket at the TSE over suspected funds from the Dark Horse film linked to the PCC. The action also questions possible irregularities in contracts involving companies connected to former President Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Mark Ruffalo, Guillermo del Toro e artistas internacionais apoiam Lula em vídeo idealizado por Kleber Mendonça
item.description: International artists including Mark Ruffalo, Tilda Swinton, and Guillermo del Toro endorse Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in a video produced by Brazilian filmmaker Kleber Mendonça Filho. The content encourages voting for Lula in the 2026 Brazilian elections, featuring a creative campaign centered on the symbolism of the letter 'L'.

item.title: Mulheres, salário e preços: as anotações de Flávio para o debate
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) traveled to Rio de Janeiro with handwritten notes on women, salaries, and prices ahead of the TV Globo presidential debate. He met with Tarcísio de Freitas to discuss strategies before facing Lula in the runoff. The debate is scheduled for 9:20 PM after the National Journal.

item.title: As nove pesquisas sobre Flávio x Lula na véspera do segundo turno da eleição
item.description: Nine polls on the Lula vs. Flávio Bolsonaro race are released the day before the 2026 runoff, covering 41,845 respondents nationally with margins of error between one and three points. Institutes including Datafolha, Quaest and AtlasIntel lead the surveys using various methods from in-person to phone interviews.

item.title: Exército do Lula chega a 10 milhões de seguidores no WhatsApp
item.description: The Lula Army channel, managed by federal deputy André Janones, reached 10 million WhatsApp followers, mobilizing supporters for digital activities and content sharing during the final stretch of the 2026 elections.

item.title: João Amoêdo, um dos fundadores do Novo, declara voto em Lula
item.description: João Amoêdo, a founder of the Novo party, endorsed Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva for the 2026 runoff, opposing Flávio Bolsonaro. In a social media post, he argued that a potential Lula administration, despite his criticisms, poses less risk than a Bolsonaro-led government, citing concerns over Flávio's lack of experience and allegations such as the 'rachadinha' scandal.

item.title: Pastor primo de André Mendonça doa para campanha de Lula
item.description: Pastor Luís Alberto de Mendonça Sabanay, cousin of Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, donated R$20,000 to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's (PT) reelection campaign. The donation was recorded by the Electoral Justice on October 10th, following the first round of elections. The pastor serves as a national director of the PT in Santa Catarina and often criticizes the use of faith by religious authorities.

item.title: X e Meta têm 24h para esclarecer ao TSE suposto favorecimento a perfis pró-Flávio
item.description: The Chief Electoral Judge ordered X and Meta to provide clarifications to the TSE within 24 hours regarding alleged irregularities in handling pro-Flávio accounts, with a daily fine of R$ 500,000 for non-compliance.

item.title: 'Exército do Lula' alcança a marca de 10 milhões de seguidores a dois dias da eleição
item.description: The 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel reached 10 million followers just before the presidential runoff debate. The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) suspended orders to block the channel, with Minister Floriano de Azevedo ruling that only a judicial decision can lead to content restrictions. The movement, led by federal deputy André Janones, is used to organize PT grassroots support ahead of the election.

item.title: "Exército do Lula": canal no WhatsApp chega a 10 milhões de seguidores
item.description: The 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel, created by federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) to support Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the 2026 elections, reached 10 million followers. The channel faced suspensions and legal actions at the TSE, but minister Floriano de Azevedo Marques ordered its permanence, citing risks of instability and misinformation. The decision favored the Coligação Brasil Pronto Pra Mais, which supports Lula.

item.title: Caso Ana Clara: ato no TSE critica decisão de Mendonça contra post de Lula
item.description: Human rights organizations protested in front of TSE against Minister André Mendonça's decision to suspend the promotion of posts linking Flávio Bolsonaro to the Ana Clara case, considered censorship. The group demands the right to publicly discuss the senator's performance during the electoral process.

item.title: Ibovespa avança 0,47% em último pregão antes do segundo turno das eleições
item.description: The Ibovespa closed up 0,47% on the last Friday before the second round of elections, driven by rising oil prices and Petrobras gains. Banks like Banco do Brasil and Bradesco also supported the index, while the dollar saw a slight decline. The market remains cautious amid a tightly contested electoral race.

item.title: Revogação de outorgas de bets antes de votação da MP no Congresso eleva insegurança jurídica no Brasil
item.description: The revocation of 85 fixed-odds betting licenses, without refund, before the vote on MP 1.394/2026 in Congress worsens legal insecurity in Brazil. Companies that invested 2.55 billion reais in licenses and 7.5 billion in equity capital now face asset losses and disruption of long-term investment plans.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Os bastidores do debate na Globo e Brasil igual ao 1º turno
item.description: The Papo Antagonista discusses the behind-the-scenes of the latest debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro before the runoff, along with polls showing a scenario unchanged from the first round.

item.title: Debate da Globo hoje: veja horário, onde assistir e regras
item.description: Globo broadcasts debate between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) on Friday (23), right after National News, simulcast on open TV, GloboNews, g1 and Globoplay. The format includes four thematic blocks with different dynamics, lasting around two hours.

item.title: Co-presidente do grupo de Doria doa R$ 2 mil para campanha de Lula
item.description: Izabella Teixeira, former minister and co-president of LIDE, donated R$ 2,000 to Lula's re-election campaign, despite João Doria supporting Flávio Bolsonaro. The contribution was made via Pix in the final stretch of the runoff.
